description: This file contains implementation code for subtitle processing, including functions for quality checks, generation, translation, and validation of subtitle files. It handles subtitle text normalization, truncation of caption lines, mock generation of subtitles, and structural validation, with imports that suggest integration with external subtitle utilities.
